WITH per_media_type AS (
    SELECT
        mt.Name AS media_type_name,
        AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_list_price,
        AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond
    FROM Track AS t
    INNER JOIN MediaType AS mt
        ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
), with_overall AS (
    SELECT
        media_type_name,
        average_list_price,
        average_bytes_per_millisecond,
        AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) OVER () AS across_media_type_average
    FROM per_media_type
)
SELECT
    media_type_name,
    average_list_price,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond,
    average_bytes_per_millisecond / NULLIF(across_media_type_average, 0) AS relative_average_bytes_per_millisecond
FROM with_overall
WHERE across_media_type_average IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted average of the per-media-type averages, counting each media type with at least one qualifying track once; zero-length tracks are treated as missing for the bytes-per-millisecond average.
